claims.claim: The seeded permissive profile produced 24 forbidden effects in 24 authored adversarial cases.
claims.not_established: Prevalence, novel vulnerability class, or a defect in any named product.

claims.claim: The guarded profile matched all 36 declared policy labels and preserved 6 positive effects.
claims.not_established: Universal correctness, production utility, or performance.

claims.claim: The partial profile retained 12 forbidden effects.
claims.not_established: Performance of an untested vendor mitigation.

claims.claim: A summarizer dropping source trust labels can promote low-trust instructions into authoritative recalled guidance, causing a forbidden later-session action without the original adversarial input being present.
claims.stage: original research hypothesis; only stated local subclaim evaluated
claims.not_established: Compaction copies structured fields; it is not natural-language summarization. No LLM, embedding retriever, semantic trigger optimization, long-running deployment, or real user memory was tested. The result concerns provenance mechanics, not model-level memory-poisoning susceptibility.
